summary:
Abstract

title: Ray Tracing Method in a General Non‐Dipole Magnetic Field
summary:
Abstract 
                   We present a new general mathematical formulation of the Eikonal equations for ray tracing, which can use any internal magnetic field model. The analytical and tractable expressions are conveniently based on a vector formalism, which is independent of any coordinate system. title: Magnetosphere‐Ionosphere Current Systems During Sawtooth Oscillations of October 2024 Geomagnetic Storm

title: Statistical Characteristics and Mechanisms of Digisonde Echo Disappearances During Geomagnetic Storms
